title: Agent cannot re-attach to its objective for post-delivery follow-up
objective: Fix re-attach and follow-up for a session after it delivers: execution_request_already_linked / invalid_session
objectiveDescription:
## Problem
An agent session cannot re-attach to its own objective after delivering, so follow-up work in the same session can't be recorded.

## Observed (Scribe mission coo:1319, objective coo:1319.4dxp, 2026-11-20)
1. A Claude Code session launched by Overlord attached and delivered successfully.
2. The user asked follow-up questions in the same session.
3. `ovld protocol update --begin-follow-up-work --session-key <original key>` failed with `Invalid or expired session key — (invalid_session)` and told the agent to run `ovld auth login`. That advice is misleading: credentials were fine.
4. `ovld protocol attach --mission-id coo:1319 --objective-id coo:1319.4dxp` was rejected with `execution_request_already_linked`.
5. The recovery it printed (retry without `--execution-request-id` / unset `OVERLORD_EXECUTION_REQUEST_ID`) failed with the same error, even with the variable removed via `env -u`. The binding seems to come from somewhere else (OVERLORD_TMPDIR / the `.overlord/tmp` session cache?).
6. Side issue: the session's TMPDIR points at `.overlord/tmp/sessions/objective-coo-1319-4dxp-.../`, which no longer exists after delivery, so shell writes to $TMPDIR fail.

## Expected
After delivery, the same agent session can start follow-up work on the objective: either the original session key stays valid for `--begin-follow-up-work`, or re-attaching to the same objective reuses or replaces the linked session. The error's recovery steps should work as printed.

## Done when
In a session launched by Overlord, after `deliver`, a plain `ovld protocol attach` on the same objective (or `update --begin-follow-up-work` with the original key) succeeds and the follow-up can be delivered.
